settings.endpoint: fixed-history recommendation regret before each row's current events
settings.contribution_scope: source-factor transfer, parameter update and structure update diagnostics
settings.source_factor_scope: source and learned factor grouping together versus full-context local history

accounting.timing_scope: input reads, source reconstruction, fixed-prefix replay and cost summaries; output summary serialization excluded

online_actual_costs.cpu_scope: individual V280 timed operations; excludes serialization, bootstrap and summary assembly
online_actual_costs.scope: actual on-policy V280 outcomes and costs; no equal-quality break-even extrapolation

paired.statistic: Sum of executed episode utility per whole memory lifecycle
paired.resampling: Within each fixed parent, resample its complete memory lifecycles; equal parent weights

A.statistic: Sum of executed episode utility per whole memory lifecycle
A.resampling: Within each fixed parent, resample its complete memory lifecycles; equal parent weights

B.statistic: Sum of executed episode utility per whole memory lifecycle
B.resampling: Within each fixed parent, resample its complete memory lifecycles; equal parent weights

A_prime.statistic: Sum of executed episode utility per whole memory lifecycle
A_prime.resampling: Within each fixed parent, resample its complete memory lifecycles; equal parent weights

inherited_dynamics_costs.scope: All actors inherit the deterministic dynamics program; only H2/MC4 references use the frozen source spawn router. Source acquisition/router costs are retained separately; old trees, selectors and outer games are not used.

inherited_source_costs.scope: Four risk_goal source learners once; reward learners and old evaluations excluded. Supplied dynamics acquisition is retained separately, not new natural feedback.

natural_planning_contribution.scope: same frozen parent/leaf knowledge; planning contribution conditional on these source models

limitations: Fixed-history variants do not execute their counterfactual recommendations.
Source-factor transfer changes both source availability and grouping.
Natural planning contrast is conditional on the same retained parent/leaf models.
